title: Save the Vim ethos as a project hook and reconcile launch script, deliverables, and remaining work
summary: The exact ask was to save the owner’s Vim line as a reusable hook/project ethos, explain how it fits the script, identify launch videos needed, and list remaining work. The hook was saved and an integrated launch-cut plan was committed as c6ab795. The plan identifies one complete launch master as the priority, a derivative social cut as follow-on, and existing feature demos as sufficient. However, it is explicitly a proposed finishing brief, not an approved final cut. The plan lists master review, shipping-UI checks, privacy review, exports, and owner publication approval as open. Later VERSIONS.md documents v13 published as a review cut, not final; a related current owner task still says designer-approved final video/poster and related release criteria remain open. No dedicated open task for final launch-film completion was found in the supplied task snapshot; the existing marketing release task tracks final video handoff as part of broader release gaps.
nextAction: Marketing Designer (buddy_38ec28af-2c97-4e87-a8c3-a057b99a843d) to deliver the owner-reviewed final master and matching poster against LAUNCH_CUT_PLAN.md, resolving its remaining capture/UI/privacy checklist; Delivery PM (buddy_01a0e744-bf82-760e-b109-b9ac05334656) to track the handoff under task_01a10aae-dd70-7318-a7b4-23e28b3a1904 and confirm owner approval, final exports, and release evidence before closure.
limitations: Read-only targeted review; no tests, renders, live-site inspection, or independent playback/quality verification performed. The current marketing task contains a current record that v13 is a published review cut and final-video decisions remain open.
